en: Enable nearby registers for 15s within 5 body lengths; 5/4/3s per guest; operators take priority; finish final guest

en: Fewer command inputs; LV3 skips commands and Circle×0.5. Prep picks LV1/2/3 (default LV3)

en: Clear all guest dissatisfaction (gone guests stay gone)

en: Tap a direction to toss the top 2 pieces; LV3=30s. Prep picks LV1/2/3 (default LV3)

en: For 5s each dash delivers matching stock without KO; misses still knock. Skill costs no stamina

zh_TW: 衝刺與奔跑不扣氣（氣 0 也能）；LV3＝15 秒。準備頁選 LV1／2／3，沒選預設 LV3
en: Dash and run cost no stamina (even at 0); LV3=15s. Prep picks LV1/2/3 (default LV3)

zh_TW: 瞬發強塞手上貨進最近可交付客人 cart；LV3＝最多 20 件。準備頁選 LV1／2／3，沒選預設 LV3
en: Instant: force held stock into nearest deliverable guest cart; LV3 up to 20. Prep picks LV1/2/3 (default LV3)

en: Two-stage: finish priority list deliveries in range; LV3=15 body lengths / up to 4 guests. Prep picks LV1/2/3 (default LV3)

en: Instant: spawn guests at the door (may exceed cap); LV3=3. Prep picks LV1/2/3 (default LV3)

zh_TW: 對準一台收銀機瞬發清隊 QUEUE／PAYING；LV3＝最多 10 人。準備頁選 LV1／2／3，沒選預設 LV3
en: Instant: clear QUEUE/PAYING at one register; LV3 up to 10. Prep picks LV1/2/3 (default LV3)

zh_TW: 兩段：預覽範圍後吸地上貨飛入手（可拆堆）；LV3＝15 身位。準備頁選 LV1／2／3，沒選預設 LV3
en: Two-stage: preview then pull floor stock into hands (can split piles); LV3=15 body lengths. Prep picks LV1/2/3 (default LV3)

zh_TW: 跟身龍捲清污（3 身位）並免疫污物；LV3＝15 秒。準備頁選 LV1／2／3，沒選預設 LV3
en: Follow-tornado clears mess (3 body lengths) and grants dirt immunity; LV3=15s. Prep picks LV1/2/3 (default LV3)

en: For 30s tossed stock auto-flies to the nearest matching shelf; if full, next tile; if all full, drops beside nearest shelf

zh_TW: 30 秒內投出的貨自動飛向最近清單需要該貨的客人；該客不要了就改飛下一位，全店沒目標則普通丟掉
en: For 30s tossed stock auto-flies to the nearest guest who needs it; retargets if they don't; normal toss if none

zh_TW: 30 秒內投出的貨自動飛向最近小偷擊中並趕走；投 1 件／一段都算一擊，擊中後貨品掉落；全店沒小偷則普通丟掉
en: For 30s tossed stock auto-hits the nearest thief and drives them off; 1 piece/segment counts; drops after hit; normal toss if none

zh_TW: You don't know the power of the dark side。抽客人當臨時員工 30 秒（準備頁選 LV1／2／3，沒選預設 LV3）
en: You don't know the power of the dark side. Recruit a guest as temp staff for 30s (prep LV1/2/3, default LV3)

zh_TW: 身旁生出玩家分身當收銀／補貨 30 秒（準備頁選 LV1／2／3，沒選預設 LV3）
en: Spawn a player clone beside you for checkout/restock for 30s (prep LV1/2/3, default LV3)

zh_TW: 衝刺撞客人不滿不增加
en: Dashing into guests does not raise dissatisfaction

en: No dirt slow; trash costs no stamina; puddles don't slip; vomit doesn't block skills

en: Time stop 10s. Input: up up down down left right left right

en: LV3: guests empty nearest shelves for 10s then queue. Input: up left down right up left down right

zh_TW: LV3：在店客人立刻按已取貨全額付款，不含離開與小偷。指令上下上下左右左右
en: LV3: in-store guests instantly pay for taken goods; excludes leavers and thieves. Input: up down up down left right left right

zh_TW: 有貨趕去排隊（只付已取）；空車離店；小偷掉贓離店。單階 CD120。指令上下上下左右左右
en: Stocked guests queue (pay taken only); empty carts leave; thieves drop loot and leave. Single-tier CD120. Input: up down up down left right left right

en: 15 successful entries in 30 real seconds (may exceed cap, no thieves). Single-tier CD120. Input: up left right down down left right up
